        dang po gzhan phyogs dgag pa ni 
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3892">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3892">sa</rs><note type="editorial">Gloss only in ID:5990</note></note> ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gsum yin la | log rtog kyang dpyad na the tshom du 'gyur bas | der 'dus pa de yang ma rtogs par 'dus shing tshad ma thams cad rang rig tu 'dus so zhes zer ro || 
        de ni ma yin te de ltar the tshom yang rjes dpag tu 'dus par 'gyur te | de rtags kyis dpyad na rjes dpag tu 'gyur ba'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
